notes.subject: זרית
notes.rationale: 'Winnow/scatter' (KJV 'compassest', JPS 'measurest'); winnowing-fan picture — sifting each step like grain — rendered 'ɲini'.

notes.subject: הסכנתה
notes.rationale: סכן 'be familiar with, cherish' — some read 'you cherish/attend to all my ways', not merely 'know'.

notes.subject: m'fɛnsɛn
notes.rationale: רבעי 'prostration for sleep', lying stretched out; rendered 'fɛnsɛn' (lying down).

translation: I ye ɲini m'sira ni m'fɛnsɛn; i dɔn m'siraw bɛɛ ⟨yɛrɛ⟩.
